name: Thai Table Time
notes: Restaurant's own domain thaitabletime.com has no menu/prices; a distinct owner-menu domain (thaitableoceanside.com) was found via search but is completely unreachable (connection timeout on both HTTPS and HTTP, two resolved IPs) so could not be used. Filed primarily from DoorDash schema.org Menu JSON-LD, address confirmed 1910 Oceanside Boulevard, Oceanside CA. Dropped 12-item 'Most Ordered' carousel as duplicates (matched by name+price to categorized items). Cross-checked against Uber Eats (same address, 1910 Oceanside Blvd): Uber Eats runs consistently ~$1.00-$2.00 higher than DoorDash on nearly all matched dishes (e.g. most $16.50 DD items are $17.50 on UE, higher-tier $24.50 DD items are $26.50 on UE) — a flat per-tier platform premium, not a clean single multiplier, and not corrected/divided out; DoorDash prices used as filed since its cent-endings are the more conventional in-house pattern. One dish, 'Praram' (steamed broccoli/spinach with peanut sauce), is DROPPED entirely: DoorDash lists it at $12.95, far off its Entrées-section siblings (all $16.50), while Uber Eats lists it at $17.50, matching the standard entree tier exactly — the two sources disagree sharply on this one item with no way to tell which is right, so it is excluded rather than guessed. DoorDash's raw capture had no 'Desserts' section at all (site nav independently confirms one exists: 'Desserts & Beverages'); added 5 dessert items from Uber Eats to fill this gap since they don't overlap/conflict with any DoorDash-listed item. A 'Salad' section shown on the restaurant's real-site nav (from an earlier search snippet) is NOT missing — the same salad dishes (Papaya Salad, House Salad, Apple Salad, Beef Salad, Shrimp/Squid Salad, Glass Noodle Salad) are present, just folded into 'Appetizers' on both DoorDash and Uber Eats. A dine-in-only 'Lunch Special' section is not offered on either delivery platform and is not included. 79 raw DoorDash items minus 1 dropped (Praram) = 78, plus 5 Uber-Eats-only desserts = 83 filed dishes.

name: Good Omen Coffee Co
notes: First-party single-page site, address confirmed (4590 Park Blvd, San Diego, CA 92116) matching the batch record; no delivery-platform links found, no login/menu gate. Most Signature Drinks list three slash-separated prices with no explicit size label in the markup (checked the raw DOM directly, e.g. around 'MOCHA $6.00 / $6.50 / $7.00' — no Small/Medium/Large text anywhere near the price); these are filed as three separate dishes labeled (Small)/(Medium)/(Large), the standard convention for a 3-tier coffee-shop price list. 'Pastries' is listed as '~ Prices Vary' with no fixed price and is excluded (no price to record, not constructible). 'Breakfast Sandwich' gives two explicit prices ($6.50 / $8.50) which the description ties directly to '+$2 add bacon' (8.50-6.50=2), so filed as two dishes: base and with-bacon. 'Vegan Breakfast Sandwich' gives only one price ($7.50) with a '+2 add Impossible Sausage' surcharge noted but no resulting total given, so only the single base price is filed (not constructing the upsell price). 'Sub Vegan Cream Cheese +.75' for bagels filed as a separate Add-On dish. Loose-decimal prices ('.75', '.50') reformatted to '$0.75'/'$0.50' to pass price format.
